verdict.rationale: Link CLI lets an agent 'retrieve permissioned financial data to answer questions about spending, balances, and trends' (e.g., 'What did I spend on dining this month?'), and buyers get 'personalized recommendations' during chat commerce — both are narrow forms of AI-generated insight from the user's own data. But this is confined to financial/transaction data surfaced via a wallet CLI and shopping recommendations, not a broader in-product analytics/insights engine over general business or usage data. Missing for 10: no evidence of general-purpose data insights/dashboards for sellers or account owners beyond spending trends, no independent corroboration of insight quality, and no coverage of suggestions outside the shopping/wallet context.
